intro1: St Ives mixes Victorian terraces by the Great Ouse with modern homes on the newer estates, and we make furniture to fit both.
intro2: Every kitchen, wardrobe and bedroom is built to your exact measurements, so it suits a characterful older room or a new build just as well. St Ives is around 24 miles from our Peterborough workshop, and the same team designs, makes and fits everything.
sty: Alcove wardrobes in a terrace, a kitchen island in a new build or a desk for working from home: each piece is made for its room.
proc_lead: Making takes four to six weeks once you approve the design. St Ives is 35 to 40 minutes away via the A1(M) and A14, part of our regular area.
steps: We measure the room in person, including chimney breasts, alcoves and any sloping ceilings in loft bedrooms. Free, with no obligation.
You see a photorealistic 3D design before anything is made, with a quote that lists every item.
Every piece is built to order in our Brassey Close workshop, to the millimetre.

bk: Send us a few photos on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll come to your St Ives home, measure up and send you a 3D design with an itemised quote, free and with no obligation.
det: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 24 miles from St Ives. As well as St Ives itself, we design and fit in Hemingford Grey, Hemingford Abbots, Houghton and Fenstanton. We cover homes up to 80 miles from Peterborough, so if you’re further out, call 01733 686767 and we’ll tell you straight away.
faqs: Do you cover St Ives and the Hemingfords?
Yes. St Ives is about 24 miles from our workshop, usually 35 to 40 minutes via the A1(M) and A14, and we fit across Hemingford Grey, Hemingford Abbots, Houghton and Fenstanton too.
Can you make wardrobes for a loft or eaves bedroom?
Yes. Loft bedrooms are common in older St Ives houses, and wardrobes made to follow the roofline are one of our specialities.
What works best in a Victorian terrace?
Fitted alcove wardrobes either side of the chimney breast, slim full-height kitchen storage for long narrow kitchens and under-stairs cupboards usually make the biggest difference.
How much should I budget for a fitted kitchen?
Straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000. Islands, premium worktops and appliances add to that. The itemised quote after your free survey shows what everything costs.
Is there somewhere I can see your work?
Yes. Our showroom is at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ. Call 01733 686767 to arrange a visit, or ask to see photos of similar jobs at your design visit.
